snippet.title: Arma: Cold War Remastered Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/65790/Arma_Cold_War_Assault_Remastered/

25 years after players first deployed to Everon, Bohemia Interactive is proud to announce the release of Arma: Cold War Assault Remastered.

Developed by our player community, this remastered edition preserves the original gameplay, missions, campaigns, and compatibility with community content, while bringing the classic experience to modern systems.
